description: Deterministic construction rulebook: agent_definition → concept/agent (AR-N001/AR-M001), fixed orchestration boundary → concept:agent:data-onboarding-agent (AR-N002/AR-M002), and M3 TRIGGERS → architecture TRIGGERS when both endpoints map (AR-R001). Consumes EngineeringModel only. This file is the rulebook, not the graph.

input.notes: Read structure exclusively from an existing EngineeringModel (engineering.nodes). Do not re-parse the repository, re-run analyzers, or create a second fact model.

node_rules.notes: agent_name is the canonical architecture identity derived deterministically from the engineering agent definition path (filename stem / attributes.name). Never embed path, .md extension, mapping rule id, analyzer name, or UUID. Multiple engineering nodes with the same canonical agent_name reuse one architecture node.

Fixed-identity orchestration boundary. Matches only the four explicit M3 engineering node ids that collectively document the Data Onboarding Agent (command, skills index, workflow docs, runbook). Not a filename scan; not analyzer-derived. Evidence is the union of contributing M3 node evidence.

mapping_rules.notes: engineering agent_definition → architecture concept/agent via CONTRIBUTES_TO. Mapping evidence is the contributing engineering node evidence.
Each listed orchestration source engineering node CONTRIBUTES_TO concept:agent:data-onboarding-agent. Mapping evidence is that engineering node's M3 evidence.

relationship_rules.notes: Elevate M3 TRIGGERS to architecture TRIGGERS only when both engineering endpoints resolve through existing mappings to architecture nodes. Evidence = M3 relationship evidence + source mapping evidence + target mapping evidence. Missing mappings → architecture.unresolved[], never a canonical edge.

identity_rules.notes: Architecture identity describes the architectural concept, not the implementation file (not concept:agent:src/foo.py or concept:agent:agent_definition:foo.md).
Stable mapping identity for the same engineering source, architecture target, and mapping kind.
Stable architecture relationship identity over architecture node ids. Same kind + endpoints → same id; no timestamps, UUIDs, or rule execution order.

evidence_rules.notes: No evidence → no canonical architectural claim. When multiple engineering nodes contribute to one architecture node, merge and deduplicate their evidence refs deterministically.

unresolved_rules.notes: If a canonical agent identity cannot be established confidently from the EngineeringModel, park the candidate in architecture.unresolved[] instead of inventing an identity. Do not guess unsupported architecture claims.

validation_rules.notes: architecture.relationships contains only validated TRIGGERS edges created by AR-R001. Engineering CONTAINS/IMPORTS/DEPENDS_ON must not be copied. Unmapped TRIGGERS candidates stay in architecture.unresolved[].

deferred: Python class named Agent → architectural agent
